quotes.text: Kristin was great. Highly recommend. Did the 1 hour freestyle tour. Can not recommend enough. You go out in the bay and have plenty of time to ride around. Big shoutout to Kristin again, as she was amazing and got us out to the spot where we were able to ride around freely. Cade /
